name: mas-architect
description: Design, lint and monitor multi-agent systems: evidence-based skills, reviewer agents, deterministic regex/rule hooks, model+effort planning per role and a live control panel.

maxConcurrentSubagents.title: Concurrent subagent limit shown in the panel
maxConcurrentSubagents.description: Read from CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS when unset here (default 20).

reportPath.title: Lint report the panel reads
reportPath.description: Relative to the session's working directory; when unset, MAS_ARCHITECT_REPORT_DIR/last-report.json if that variable is set.

staleAfterSeconds.title: Seconds of silence before a running agent reads as stalled
staleAfterSeconds.description: A running agent with no turn or tool event for this long is flagged 'stalled?' (alive but not progressing).

maxNestingDepth.title: Subagent nesting depth limit
maxNestingDepth.description: Claude Code allows 3 levels; the panel colours the depth row red at or over this value.

maxConcurrentWorkflowAgents.title: Concurrent workflow agent limit
maxConcurrentWorkflowAgents.description: The second concurrency bar, for agents a Workflow script starts (default maxConcurrency 16).

refreshSeconds.title: Panel refresh interval in seconds
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads agents and usage; events refresh it sooner.
